subject: Packaging and pricing: storage retention, tracing sampling, and dashboard seats
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@atlashealth.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging questions: retention tiers, trace sampling, and dashboard seat pricing

Hi Chloe / Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the runtime performance looked promising. Before we lock in a commitment, our finance and infra teams need a clearer mapping of how observability add-ons are priced so we can model TCO. Two specific asks:

1) Retention storage: we saw reference to "retention buckets" in the slide deck. Can you confirm how storage/retention is metered? Is it GB-month, daily snapshots, or a mix? If GB-month, what happens to partial-month usage and during rollouts (pro-rate)?

2) Tracing/sample budgets: we need to understand how traces are billed relative to sampling rates and indexed spans. If we lower sampling from 100% to 10% for low-priority routes, how does that change cost and visibility in the advanced dashboards?

3) Dashboard seats & advanced widgets: are seats per-user or per-dashboard-view? We have 25 users but expect only ~6 heavy users. Is there a seat-concurrency option or a "view-only" priced tier?

4) Discounts & packaging: our procurement requires volume thresholds tied to committed spend. Can you outline typical discount breakpoints (monthly commit or annual) and whether credits can be applied toward add-ons vs core inference?

Attached: a short spreadsheet with our expected retention profile and rough request volumes. Please call out any gotchas so we can build a clean comparison against our current provider.

Goal: have a final pricing sketch by EOM so procurement can include it in the Q4 renewal package.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Platform Engineering
Atlas Health

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@atlashealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging questions: retention tiers, trace sampling, and dashboard seat pricing

Thanks Elena — really helpful context and great to hear the demo was useful. I pulled together a short pricing sketch and a couple notes; attaching an editable workbook (observability-pricing-model.xlsx) that maps your retention profile to cost lines. Quick answers below, then proposed next steps.

- Retention storage: primary billing is GB-month for persisted indices (snapshots and trace indexes). We also surface a "hot-window" surcharge for retention <7 days to reflect higher IO on hot storage. Partial-months are pro-rated at the GB-hour level in the event of start/stop within a billing period.

- Tracing: billing is two-part: ingested span volume (per 10k spans) + indexed spans (per GB of index). Lowering sampling from 100% to 10% reduces ingested spans proportionally; however some advanced features (span-based alerts / waterfall views) require indexed spans — we recommend keeping a small percentage (1–2%) of traces indexed for critical routes. The workbook has a sample calculation comparing 100%/50%/10% sampling.

- Dashboards & seats: we offer user seats (full) and a "viewer" seat at 35% of a full seat. For orgs with many light users we can mix seats and viewers. There is also an API-key-based programmatic seat for systems that render dashboards in internal apps (priced like a viewer).

- Discounts & packaging: standard breakpoints are 10k GB-month, 50k GB-month, 200k GB-month (or equivalent committed spend thresholds $50k/mo, $150k/mo, $400k/mo). Discounts increase with commitment term length (12 vs 36 months) and with combined bundling across core inference + add-ons. Credits are generally applied against add-ons first unless contract specifies otherwise; we can make credits fungible at the enterprise level.

Next steps:
1) I updated the workbook with a baseline run using your attached profile — see tab "Atlas base".
2) Can we schedule a 30m pricing walk-through early next week? I can invite Marissa and Karthik for discount/contract questions.

Attaching: observability-pricing-model.xlsx, trace-sample-plan.pdf

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Atlas discount posture and negotiation points

Chloe / Karthik — quick internal note before the call with Atlas:

- Atlas appears willing to commit if we make add-on credits flexible. We should limit fungibility to up to 25% of annual add-on spend to protect core revenue.
- For retention buckets: propose a 6-month promotional uplift (no hot-window surcharge) if they commit to 12 months at $75k+/mo equivalent — reduces friction during migration and keeps economics intact.
- Tracing indexed spans: suggest offering an initial 30-day 'index trial' where we index 2% of spans for a single service to validate signal; charge regular rates after trial. If they convert to a paid indexed plan within 45 days, apply a one-time credit equal to 50% of the trial indexing charges.
- Seats: offer 6 full seats + 10 viewers in the quote; price viewers at 40% for first year as a concession.

I'll join the call to lead commercial terms — goal is to get a verbal commit and move to Heads of Terms.

Marissa
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlashealth.io>

Subject: Re: Packaging questions: retention tiers, trace sampling, and dashboard seat pricing

Thanks — this is super helpful. We reviewed the workbook and the suggested concessions look reasonable. Two quick clarifications before the call:

1) If we accept the 12-month $75k/mo path with the 6-month hot-window waiver, will you put the waiver in writing in the SOW (we need it for our procurement)?
2) For the index trial: can you confirm the measurement window and whether we can toggle index targets per-service from our console? If the trial auto-charges, please include a pre-notification email 7 days before billing.

We'll be on the call Monday at 10am PT. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Samir
VP Engineering
Atlas Health
